editorial:
Imagine being so desperate for cash that you decide to sell tours of a giant concrete highway. That is exactly what Martin and Renato do in this quirky little flick. They start a coach tour around the M25, which is basically the massive ring road around London. It sounds like a terrible idea because, well, it is just a road, but the duo is convinced they have found a goldmine. The vibe is very lighthearted and silly, focusing on two guys who are completely out of their depth but refuse to give up on their dream. It is a classic buddy comedy where everything that can go wrong eventually does, leading to some pretty funny situations.

You will probably love the chemistry between the leads, as their bickering keeps the energy high even when the plot slows down. While it is an older TV movie, the humor holds up if you like awkward mistakes and bad luck. The pacing is steady, and it never feels too long.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with the tour becoming a total train wreck. After trying so hard to make the M25 look exciting, the guys realize that nobody actually wants to pay to sit on a bus and look at a motorway. Their big plans fall apart in a chaotic finale where their ambition finally crashes. They end up right back where they started, broke and luckless, but with a funny story to tell about their failed business.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky comedies about failing upwards.
